name: Locked Love
source:
In this story, Ren kept the MC captive and, over time, they conceived a daughter. Meanwhile, Ren remains immersed in the dark world of live-streaming, earning money by broadcasting the torture of his victims in the basement.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251107171338/https://diositareme.itch.io/locked-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个故事中，任俘虏了MC，随着时间的推移，他们怀上了一个女儿。与此同时，任仍然沉浸在直播的黑暗世界中，通过直播地下室受害者的酷刑来赚钱。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251107171338/https://diositareme.itch.io/locked-love]Itch.io[/url]]
